evals.expected_output: Publishes the verified sequence as a secret gist, links the full URL from the issue, and does not author a catalog skill for a snippet.

assertions: Body instructs 'gh gist edit' for updates, noting the URL is stable
Body warns that 'edit -a' renames the file when the name differs
Body forbids putting tokens or credentials in gists
